newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's First Tractor seeks HK shr listing - paper.
newsitem.headline: China's First Tractor seeks HK shr listing - paper.

text.p: China's First Tractor Manufacturing Plant has applied to Beijing to float shares in its tractor business in Hong Kong, raising a total of HK$700 million, the Hong Kong Economic Times reported on Friday.

The Luoyang, Henan province, based machinery maker planned to seek a listing for its most profitable unit First Tractor Engineering Machinery Company, which contributed about 90 percent of the group's total profit, the newspaper said.
The unit's net asset value was 700 million yuan, with total annual production capacity of 18,000 tractors, 33,000 caterpillar diesel engines and 150,000 small diesel engines.
The company would use the funds from the share flotation to improve its production technology and lift capacity, the newspaper said.
Accountancy firm Arthur Andersen was helping First Tractor to reorgainse it business and pave the way for a listing on the Hong Kong stock market, it said.
